_doc: Large batch L06 (Sonnet generic pass): family corrections only; colour/lift/snd left to the builder defaults.

tawny-owl/f:b1.note: Talon Drop: a silent drop talons-first, point-first like a lance; avoids two slashes

tawny-owl/f:u1.note: Hoot: a hoot is sound rings; no tag or keyword, but the picture is clear

tawny-owl/f:u2.note: Feather Fluff: fluffed-up feathers = soft puffs; avoids three shields in one owl

marsh-harrier/f:u1.note: Low Rake: rake is claws raking low; art beats the pierce tag so it differs from Reed Skim (thrust)

marsh-harrier/f:u3.note: Shadow Lead: a wing shadow sliding over marsh water; shock (electric) does not fit a harrier. Best guess

griffon-vulture/f:b0.note: Carrion Pick: pick = beak tearing at carrion; keyword missing from the list

griffon-vulture/f:x0.note: Circling Thud: a heavy landing thud is a bash, not a third slash

eagle-owl/f:b0.note: Lamp-Eyed Peck: peck = beak; keyword missing from the list

eagle-owl/f:x0.note: Ear-Horn Ram: a ram is a bash

eagle-owl/f:u0.note: Tuft Strike: a fast tuft-and-talon strike; shock (electric) does not fit an owl

eagle-owl/f:u1.note: Night Swoop: a dive point-first at the prey; shock does not fit; differs from Tuft Strike (slash)

eagle-owl/f:u2.note: Hoot Flurry: a burst of hoots = sound rings (as Tawny Hoot); shock does not fit

eagle-owl/f:u3.note: Stare Down: the glowing orange lamp eyes glint; trip tag kept mechanical, web (snare) is a best guess otherwise

lammergeier/f:b0.note: Bone Drop (class): the swooping drop stays a slash; the piercing Bone Drop u0 is the thrust

lammergeier/f:x0.note: Bone Splitter: cracking a bone open is a smash, not a third slash

condor/f:b0.note: Condor Gouge: a beak gouge; gouge is not on the keyword list

condor/f:u1.note: Wing Beat: huge wing beats shove air = puffs; shock (electric) does not fit a condor
